Amphictyŏnes , um (acc. Gr. -ăs;
I. v. infra ), m., = Ἀμφικτύονες, the political and religious assembly of the confederated Greek States at Thermopylœ, later at Delphi, the Amphictyons (cf. Tittm. Amphyct. Bund, Heeren Ideen, 3, 196): “Thebani accusantur apud Amphictyonas,” Cic. Inv. 2, 23 ; Quint. 5, 10, 111: “decreto Amphictyonum,” Tac. A. 4, 14 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
